title: Composition of smooth morphisms is smooth
statement: Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $g:X\to Y$ and $f:Y\to Z$ be smooth morphisms [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Then the composite $f\circ g:X\to Z$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

source.place: Tag 01VA, lemma-composition-smooth: the composition of two morphisms which are smooth is smooth (Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_comp, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Smooth.lean lines 109-111).
